blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte on Monday pushed back against National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag’s claim that he owns a property on Samal Island, a resort city. Duterte said Matibag should conduct due diligence when investigating such claims and avoid trumpeting unverified assertions. “If you claim that I own a resort in Samal, then I suggest you do what an investigator is expected to do – establish the facts and present evidence,” he said in a Facebook post. “The NBI is an investigative institution, not a platform for trial by publicity,” he added. “The public […]...
